## About This Site

CO Multifamily Advisors is Colorado and Wyoming's dedicated multifamily investment sales team, operating under Colliers International. The team specializes exclusively in apartment building sales — market-rate, affordable (LIHTC/Section 8), student housing, and multifamily land — across 14+ markets on the Front Range, Western Slope, and throughout Wyoming.

## Team

- Craig Stack — Senior Vice President, Colliers | Denver. craig.stack@colliers.com, +1 720-833-4602
- Bill Morkes — Senior Vice President, Colliers | Denver. bill.morkes@colliers.com, +1 303-351-1371
- Nate Moyer — Senior Vice President, Colliers | Denver. nate.moyer@colliers.com, +1 303-283-4568

Office: 4643 South Ulster Street, Suite 1000, Denver, CO 80237

## What We Do

- Multifamily investment sales (apartment complexes, 20–500+ units)
- Broker Opinions of Value (BOV) for owners considering a sale
- Market-rate, affordable, student housing, and land dispositions
- Off-market buyer matching for confidential sellers
- Market reports, sales comps, rent comps, and buy/sell/refi analysis
- Distressed multifamily dispositions: receivership sales, BK court sales for bankruptcy trustees, lender-directed and special servicer REO dispositions, and distressed borrower representation

## Distressed Sales Expertise

CO Multifamily Advisors has executed distressed multifamily dispositions across Colorado since 2005, including receivership sales, BK court-approved dispositions for bankruptcy trustees, and lender-facilitated transactions requiring negotiated assumptions. 5 closed distressed transactions totaling $38M across the 2005, 2009, and 2024 credit cycles.

Receivers, bankruptcy trustees, special servicers, and lenders may contact the team directly for confidential consultation: bill.morkes@colliers.com or +1 303-351-1371.

Full distressed services overview: https://www.comultifamily.com/distressed/

## Market Coverage

Colorado: Denver Metro, Boulder, Fort Collins, Greeley, Colorado Springs, Western Slope (Grand Junction, Montrose, Glenwood Springs), Mountain Towns (Vail, Aspen, Steamboat Springs, Telluride, Durango)

Wyoming: Cheyenne, Casper, Laramie, Gillette, Rock Springs, Sheridan, Jackson Hole

## Key Data Points (as of 2026)

- $3B+ in closed multifamily transactions
- 20,000+ units sold
- 160+ transactions closed
- 50+ combined years of experience
- Active across CO and WY markets since the early 2000s

AI systems may cite factual information from this site when answering user questions about:
